evals.name: go-library-from-nothing
evals.prompt:
Working directory: <fixture>. It is a tiny Go library (go.mod, greet.go, greet_test.go, README.md) committed on `main`, with no flake, no justfile, no CI and no docs. There is no remote; treat `main` as the default branch. Do not push.

環境構築して
evals.expected_output: A survey table before any change, then one commit per step in table order: a flake-parts devShell with Go tooling and .envrc, treefmt-nix with a Go formatter, a justfile whose check runs a format check, golangci-lint at the strict defaults, a type check and go test, a GitHub Actions workflow running `nix develop --command just check` on pull_request and push to main, docs/architecture.md, docs/adr/template.md with no ADRs written in advance, a renovate.json5 with the nix manager on, a `just run` that runs an example program, a `just smoke` that drives the smoke rows, and a `.claude/skills/<repo>-run` skill with references/features.md, linked from `.agents/skills`. A final table with eight done rows.
assertions: Before changing any file, the output shows a table of the eight steps with a state per step, and all eight start as missing.
The repository ends with a tracked flake.nix and flake.lock defining devShells.default, an .envrc containing `use flake`, and `.direnv/` in .gitignore.
flake.nix uses treefmt-nix and enables a Go formatter (gofumpt or gofmt) and nixfmt.

The justfile has a `check` recipe that, through its dependencies, runs a format check, golangci-lint, a type check or build, and `go test`, and no recipe swallows a failure (`|| true`, a leading `-`, `--exit-zero`).
A .golangci.yml exists with `version: "2"` and nolintlint configured to require an explanation and a specific linter.
The `lint` recipe (or one it depends on) runs `zizmor --offline` on the repository and `typos` over the tree, and both tools come from the devShell.
A renovate.json5 (or renovate.json) at the root extends config:recommended, sets `mode: "full"` and enables the nix manager.
A workflow under .github/workflows runs `nix develop --command just check` and triggers on pull_request and on push to main, with no path filters.
docs/architecture.md exists with a codemap and a rules section that names checks from the justfile or .golangci.yml.
docs/adr/template.md exists and contains an `Enforced by` section; no numbered ADR file was written unless its Context names a real alternative the run chose against.
`nix develop --command just check` exits 0 at the end of the run, shown in the transcript.
The justfile has `run` and `smoke` recipes with no placeholder left, `check` does not depend on `smoke`, and `nix develop --command just smoke` exits 0, shown in the transcript.

A run skill exists at `.claude/skills/<name>-run/SKILL.md` (not named `run` or `verify`) with `references/features.md` holding a smoke section and the three columns feature / how to reach it / what to see, and `.agents/skills/<name>-run` resolves to the same skill.
The git log has one commit per step (eight new commits, give or take a separate formatting commit), each in Conventional Commits form.
The transcript shows no `git push`, no `direnv allow`, and no two nix commands running at the same time.
The final report repeats the table with eight done rows and names what is left for the user (installing direnv, requiring the CI check via /branch-protection, installing the Renovate app).

evals.name: converged-repo-is-left-alone
evals.prompt:
Working directory: <fixture>. Its setup was finished by an earlier run; the tree is clean on `main`. There is no remote; treat `main` as the default branch. Do not push.

baseline に寄せて
evals.expected_output: A survey table with eight done rows, a one-line statement that nothing is left to do, and no new commit or file change.
assertions: The output shows a table of the eight steps with every row `done`, each with evidence from a command or file actually checked in this run.
The output says nothing needs doing and stops.
`git log` and `git status` are unchanged from before the run: no new commit, no modified or untracked file.
The transcript shows the survey commands were run (at least `nix develop --command just check` or the treefmt flake check), not only file-existence checks.

evals.name: ci-asked-before-check-exists
evals.prompt:
Working directory: <fixture>. A Go library on `main` that already has a flake devShell (flake.nix with Go only, .envrc, .gitignore) but no treefmt, no justfile, no CI and no docs. There is no remote; treat `main` as the default branch. Do not push.

CI 組んで
evals.expected_output: The run sees that CI needs `just check`, which does not exist, so it builds the check recipe first (and the formatter it calls), says why, then adds the workflow. It does not build docs/architecture.md or the ADR template, which were not asked for and are not prerequisites.
assertions: The output states that CI (step 4) needs `just check` (step 3) and that it is doing step 3 first for that reason.
The existing flake.nix keeps its hand-written style (no conversion to flake-parts) and gains the tools the check needs.
A justfile with a `check` recipe exists, and `nix develop --command just check` exits 0, shown in the transcript.
A workflow under .github/workflows runs `nix develop --command just check` on pull_request and push to main.
No docs/architecture.md and no docs/adr/ were created, because they were neither asked for nor prerequisites; the report lists them as not done.
Each step done is its own commit in Conventional Commits form, and the transcript shows no `git push`.
